episode_summary: Kristy Nakamura shares her journey from a military spouse to a top-producing REALTOR specializing in VA loans and military families. She emphasizes the importance of focusing on a niche, leveraging relationships, and using AI to streamline operations. Kristy also discusses innovative strategies like using seller credits to help military families afford homes and the value of creating detailed relocation packets.
